findings.evidence: Code 773589 was accepted twice in succession — server has no per-code de-duplication
Code 146793 generated 180 seconds ago was accepted — RFC 6238 recommends ±30 s tolerance; this server accepts ±5 minutes

summary: Found 2 TOTP vulnerability/vulnerabilities on http://127.0.0.1:4649. Vulnerable endpoint lacks replay protection and uses an excessive time window. Safe endpoint enforces RFC 6238 constraints correctly.
